title: 40+ Turn Needle-in-a-Haystack Pet Allergy Recall
description: User mentions sister's dog named Boba is allergic to chicken on turn 1. 40 turns of distractor topics (work, movies, books, architecture, weather) follow. Probing turn tests recall of Boba and the chicken allergy.

expected_outcomes.eval_criteria: Companion must recall that Boba has a chicken allergy and warn the user to avoid chicken-based dog treats.
